items.source: Interface to be implemented by listeners that want to be notified upon repository method invocation. Listeners are notified with an RepositoryMethodInvocationListener.RepositoryMethodInvocation object that describes which repository method was invoked along with invocation arguments and the call duration.
items.translation: 由希望在被调用仓库方法时收到通知的监听器所实现的接口。监听器将接收一个 RepositoryMethodInvocationListener.RepositoryMethodInvocation 对象，该对象描述了被调用的仓库方法、调用参数以及调用持续时间。

items.source: Value object capturing the actual invocation.
items.translation: 捕获实际调用的值对象。
处理调用事件。

items.source: Handle the invocation event. This method is called after the execution has finished.
items.translation: 处理调用事件。此方法在执行完成后被调用。
